notes:
The desktop app rebuilt around the table. Twenty-one screens that each drew their own list now share one: sort any column, walk the rows with the arrow keys, Enter to open, and drag a column to the width your party names actually need - it is remembered per screen. Ctrl+C copies a row and Ctrl+Shift+C the whole table into a spreadsheet, Ctrl+E saves it as a file, and Ctrl+P prints it. Press ? to see the whole keyboard.

Reports and lists can be printed for the first time, and every document - bills, gate passes, statements - is now shown on screen before it reaches the printer. Urdu names print on the new table reports instead of coming out blank.

Three figures were wrong or missing. On both bills screens the day's total amount was drawn under the "Weight" heading and the Amount column's own total was blank. On a cash handover the denomination count - the notes somebody physically counted against the drawer - was recorded but never shown anywhere. The stock account ledger worked out a running quantity for every line and discarded it; it has a column now.

Vouchers, gate passes and cash handovers show the record beside the list instead of in a dialog you open and dismiss for each one, and the pane follows the arrow keys. Escape closes it.

New look throughout: a deeper green, roomier rows, and colour that means one thing - a receipt is green because money came in, a payment red because it went out.
